title: Ammonium and Phosphate Recovery in a Three Chambered Microbial Electrolysis Cell: Towards Obtaining Struvite from Livestock Manure

metadata.title: Ammonium and Phosphate Recovery in a Three Chambered Microbial Electrolysis Cell: Towards Obtaining Struvite from Livestock Manure
metadata.description: Research data on recovering ammonium and phosphate through a three-chambered microbial electrolysis cell system, with the objective of producing struvite as a recoverable product from livestock manure.
